title: CSI: Grave Danger
overview: "Grave Danger" is a feature-length, two-part episode that served as the Season 5 finale of CSI: Crime Scene Investigation in 2005. Written and directed by legendary filmmaker Quentin Tarantino, the movie-length special features the entire Las Vegas team racing against time to save investigator Nick Stokes, who is kidnapped and buried alive in a glass casket
